title: Run one more real Delivery tool-backed parallel dispatch before worktree automation
summary: Peter accepted recommendation to hold automatic git worktree creation and instead run one additional real Delivery-owned tool-backed dispatch rep using the lock-manifest gate and isolated-copy discipline.

body.decision: Do not implement automatic worktree creation yet; run one more real Delivery dispatch rep first.
body.scope: Delivery-owned internal operating artifacts only; use file-scope lock checker as required pre-dispatch gate.
body.close_when: The additional dispatch rep is validated, evidenced, and either confirms worktree automation should still wait or identifies concrete automation requirements.

proposed_action: Run a bounded tool-backed parallel dispatch rep against real Delivery operating artifacts before worktree automation.
requested_action: Run a bounded tool-backed parallel dispatch rep against real Delivery operating artifacts before worktree automation.
success_signal: A real Delivery dispatch rep passes with lock-gate evidence and friction captured for automation/no-automation decision.
